paragraphs.text:
Together, you and Sylvia struggle to the shore. Safe on dry land, 
you disengage and lie staring into the sky, gasping for breath 
and waiting for Norman to join you.

Your academic commitment fades. For what purpose have 
you been risking your lives? To enter what is probably an empty 
box  canyon? The  expedition  is  in  a  shambles.  It’s  time  you 
ended it.

If required, you may attempt First Aid rolls: if you succeed, you may 
restore 1D3 hit points to Sylvia and yourself. Go to 324.
